notes: No document in the repository assigns a stable branch ID; `id` and the filename are minted as <weaponId>-<branch-name-kebab-case> per the transcription convention.

Prerequisites, exclusivity, and the two-unit cost model are stated in docs/65-weapon-stat-and-branch-upgrades.md lines 66 and 68; the cost resource and amount for this branch come from this section's heading.
`rules` holds every bullet of the section verbatim with its source line; `effects` is the structured transcription of those same bullets.

expectedEffect.scalesWith: how well the primary impact catches a cluster

rules.text: Each enemy hit by the primary blast seeds a secondary blast 0.40 s later at that enemy's original hit position.
Each secondary blast deals 40% current Damage and has 60% current blast radius.
Secondary blasts do not seed more blasts. A target can take no more than two secondary-blast hits from one primary shell.
Expected effect: approximately +40–100% horde throughput, scaling with how well the primary impact catches a cluster.
